interface.signature: findOrder(dict: List[str], N: int, K: int) -> str

preconditions.description: The input dict is a list of strings with length exactly N.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(w, str) and 1 <= len(w) <= 50 for w in dict)
preconditions.description: Each word in dict is a non-empty string with length between 1 and 50.
K is an integer between 1 and 26 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:K] for c in w) for w in dict)
preconditions.description: All characters in all words are among the first K lowercase English letters.
N is an integer between 1 and 300 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The returned string has length K and contains exactly K distinct characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:K] for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the returned string is one of the first K lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(all(return_value.index(dict[i][j]) < return_value.index(dict[i+1][j]) for j in range(min(len(dict[i]), len(dict[i+1])))) for i in range(N-1))
postconditions.description: For every adjacent pair of words in the sorted dictionary, the first differing character appears earlier in the returned order string than the corresponding character in the next word.
